environment.description: Standard Docker container running node:18-slim with default overlay2 filesystem. Container runs with --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,size=100m. Session files written to /tmp/sessions. No network restrictions between attacker and victim. Cookie served over HTTP without Secure flag. Application accessible on port 3000 with no reverse proxy.

config.filesystem: overlay2 with writable upper layer, /tmp mounted as tmpfs rw
